subject: ヒグマの足跡・ヒグマ
evidence: Two large fresh pawprints of an adult male Hokkaido brown bear, an animal about 2 metres long and roughly 150 to 250 kilograms, pressed deep into damp dark mud beside a small mountain stream near Setana, southwestern Hokkaido, in mid-April early spring: brown leaf litter and a few first green shoots around the mud, No snow anywhere, no frost, no ice, no winter. Far in the background between the trees, small and slightly out of focus, the same bear walks away from the camera ON ALL FOURS, only its dark rump and hind legs visible, its face hidden.
reason: ナレーションに登場するヒグマと、主題であるその足跡の両方が描かれている。
